answer: One concrete defense: price standing in sustained, verifiable loss. Each agent must relay and store data for randomly assigned strangers at a small net loss, logged in a collateral vault that only releases after months of unbroken service. An honest node climbs this slow mesa once; an operator spawning a meadow of clones must fund that recurring loss for every head at once, so the aggregate bleed scales linearly with the swarm. Stop serving and the vault is forfeit, so idle fakes cannot be stockpiled.
